description: This file defines the IStreamIdentity interface, which provides a way to uniquely identify a stream by its Guid and Namespace within the Orleans.Streams namespace.

classes.name: IStreamIdentity
classes.description: An interface that provides properties to uniquely identify a stream via a Guid and a Namespace.

methods.name: Guid
methods.description: Property that returns the unique identifier of the stream.

methods.name: Namespace
methods.description: Property that returns the namespace of the stream.
